module rtlpp_06838
(
	  input clk, 
	  output clock_1MHz,
	  output clock_100kHz,
	  output clock_10kHz,
	  output clock_1kHz,
	  output clock_100Hz,
	  output clock_10Hz,
	  output clock_1Hz,
	  output clock_01Hz,
	  output clock_1s, 
	  output clock_100ms, 
	  output clock_10ms, 
	  output clock_1ms, 
	  output clock_100us, 
	  output clock_10us, 
	  output clock_1us
);

	wire clk_1MHz;
	wire clk_100kHz;
	wire clk_10kHz;
	wire clk_1kHz;
	wire clk_100Hz;
	wire clk_10Hz;
	wire clk_1Hz;
	wire clk_01Hz;

	assign clock_1s = clk_1Hz;
	assign clock_100ms = clk_10Hz;
	assign clock_10ms = clk_100Hz;
	assign clock_1ms = clk_1kHz;
	assign clock_100us = clk_10kHz;
	assign clock_10us = clk_100kHz;
	assign clock_1us = clk_1MHz;
	
	// Embedded divider_50 logic
	reg [5:0] count_50;
	reg clk_div50;
	always @(posedge clk) begin
		if (count_50 == 24) begin
			count_50 <= 0;
			clk_div50 <= ~clk_div50;
		end else begin
			count_50 <= count_50 + 1;
		end
	end
	assign clk_1MHz = clk_div50;
	
	// Embedded divider_10 logic instances
	reg [3:0] count_10_1;
	reg clk_div10_1;
	always @(posedge clk_1MHz) begin
		if (count_10_1 == 4) begin
			count_10_1 <= 0;
			clk_div10_1 <= ~clk_div10_1;
		end else begin
			count_10_1 <= count_10_1 + 1;
		end
	end
	assign clk_100kHz = clk_div10_1;

	reg [3:0] count_10_2;
	reg clk_div10_2;
	always @(posedge clk_100kHz) begin
		if (count_10_2 == 4) begin
			count_10_2 <= 0;
			clk_div10_2 <= ~clk_div10_2;
		end else begin
			count_10_2 <= count_10_2 + 1;
		end
	end
	assign clk_10kHz = clk_div10_2;

	reg [3:0] count_10_3;
	reg clk_div10_3;
	always @(posedge clk_10kHz) begin
		if (count_10_3 == 4) begin
			count_10_3 <= 0;
			clk_div10_3 <= ~clk_div10_3;
		end else begin
			count_10_3 <= count_10_3 + 1;
		end
	end
	assign clk_1kHz = clk_div10_3;

	reg [3:0] count_10_4;
	reg clk_div10_4;
	always @(posedge clk_1kHz) begin
		if (count_10_4 == 4) begin
			count_10_4 <= 0;
			clk_div10_4 <= ~clk_div10_4;
		end else begin
			count_10_4 <= count_10_4 + 1;
		end
	end
	assign clk_100Hz = clk_div10_4;

	reg [3:0] count_10_5;
	reg clk_div10_5;
	always @(posedge clk_100Hz) begin
		if (count_10_5 == 4) begin
			count_10_5 <= 0;
			clk_div10_5 <= ~clk_div10_5;
		end else begin
			count_10_5 <= count_10_5 + 1;
		end
	end
	assign clk_10Hz = clk_div10_5;

	reg [3:0] count_10_6;
	reg clk_div10_6;
	always @(posedge clk_10Hz) begin
		if (count_10_6 == 4) begin
			count_10_6 <= 0;
			clk_div10_6 <= ~clk_div10_6;
		end else begin
			count_10_6 <= count_10_6 + 1;
		end
	end
	assign clk_1Hz = clk_div10_6;

	reg [3:0] count_10_7;
	reg clk_div10_7;
	always @(posedge clk_1Hz) begin
		if (count_10_7 == 4) begin
			count_10_7 <= 0;
			clk_div10_7 <= ~clk_div10_7;
		end else begin
			count_10_7 <= count_10_7 + 1;
		end
	end
	assign clk_01Hz = clk_div10_7;
	
endmodule
